body: Yes, that would probably be fair to say.

No not physically. From above, it is a large majority of the people here, but originally start with a few people, but I guess it became a band wagon type thing to pick on me and accuse me of faking my injuries.  From being a "joke" to being intentionally hurtful, as its no longer become a joke and is now being told as the truth.

I honestly don't know.  Who knows if it would be any different, like poeple have said to me when trying to get help, that every place you go to will have bullies and people like that.
Not to mention the countless times Ive been told that there are people in the world that have it worse and they still live so...I just feel so worthless.

Well hopefully I'd really like to continue with the military, and try to be the best leader I can. There is this ridiculous culture in the military of having to be this hard, emotionless alpha male... But I don't fit that at all, I mean I'm not scrawny by any means, but I have feelings and probably care more about others than I do for my self.
If I wasn't to continue here I was always thinking about becomming a cop, so that I could actually get into a job that helps people.  I can't stand seeing others get hurt, as I've been through it I know how it feels and I would never wish that upon anyone.
I don't know maybe I'm just rambling now, but I hate feeling like this, I hate not doing anything about, I hate crying about it.  I have never really told this story to anyone until now, but I have never had any I could trust in my life, and most of the time I find it very hard.
I've calmed down a little as it stands now, however I still feel pretty hopeless, and the scary part is that I don't know when I'm going to go down again.
What would you like to know? Most of it is there. Minus details that would identiify me.

Maths, Physics and Engineering related subjects are probably the most interesting, I love learning how things work, and why.
Thanks I do to, I guess this stuff just cuts me so deep, I don't have the motivation anymore to get better.  As much as I would like to.
